mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_access_grant (dataset_id, user_id, role_id, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{roleId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{grantedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

choose.when: MERGE INTO dataset_access_grant t USING (SELECT #{datasetId} AS d, #{userId} AS sid FROM DUAL) s ON (CASE WHEN t.dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.dataset_id END = s.d AND CASE WHEN t.dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.user_id END = s.sid) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (dataset_id, user_id, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES (s.d, s.sid, #{grantedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, )
choose.otherwise: MERGE INTO dataset_access_grant t USING (SELECT #{datasetId} AS d, #{roleId} AS sid FROM DUAL) s ON (CASE WHEN t.dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND t.role_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.dataset_id END = s.d AND CASE WHEN t.dataset_id IS NOT NULL AND t.role_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.role_id END = s.sid) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (dataset_id, role_id, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES (s.d, s.sid, #{grantedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, )

INSERT INTO dataset_access_grant (dataset_id, user_id, role_id, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT #{toDatasetId}, src.user_id, src.role_id, #{grantedBy}NULL,
FROM dataset_access_grant src WHERE src.dataset_id = #{fromDatasetId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dataset_access_grant t WHERE t.dataset_id = #{toDatasetId} AND (t.user_id = src.user_id OR (t.user_id IS NULL AND src.user_id IS NULL)) AND (t.role_id = src.role_id OR (t.role_id IS NULL AND src.role_id IS NULL)))

mapper.sql: SELECT g.id, g.dataset_id, g.user_id, g.role_id, CASE WHEN g.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN su.name ELSE r.name END AS subject_name, g.granted_by, gb.name AS granted_by_name, g.granted_at FROM dataset_access_grant g LEFT JOIN su ON su.id = g.user_id LEFT JOIN role r ON r.id = g.role_id LEFT JOIN gb ON gb.id = g.granted_by
